package.name: pinkrab_policy
package.description:
A trained policy, driving the arms. It shows the policy what the arms' gripper cameras see, off the live view that records them, composes each tool motion it answers with onto where that tool was last put, solves the arm for it, and publishes /joint_commands through the safety gate. Every run is recorded as a rollout, and the handhelds can take the arms over to correct it (DAgger). Also `pinkrab-train`, lerobot-train with every logged number kept in a file for the studio's training page.
Its own package because it belongs on the operator's side of the rig and drags the policy, the cameras and the kinematics in with it - none of which the driver holding the servo bus should have to install.
